title: QUAKE II q2ded
subtitle: id Software, 1997 · the Solaris port, and id's Solaris port is a dedicated SERVER
argsHint: `+map <name>` is the level the server runs. `+set dedicated 1` is what its own makefile builds for: solaris/Makefile.Solaris links cl_null.c and cd_null.c and produces q2ded, so there is no client here and nothing to look at but what the server says.

needsData.hint: baseq2/pak0.pak — the same data the client uses

_why: The half of Quake II no other target here exercises alone. It loads the pak, dlopens gamei386.so, spawns the world and runs its own frame loop, printing what it does -- with no renderer in the build at all.
_network: UDP_OpenSocket fails, twice, and says so: a browser has no socket to give and this target's env is stdio+dl. A dedicated server with no network still runs its world, which is what makes it worth having; a real one would take clients.
